result:
I've finished round 304 (PERF-3c), and the PERF-3 exit target is **not met**: on the out-first path, keydown is 80 ms (median of 3 passes), above the 50 ms target. Commits stay at 1 per key on all three paths, so that half of the target holds. The fix is PERF-3d; I made no app change. No STOP condition came up, and there was no commit or push.

**What changed:** exactly the 8 paths the task allows (5 modified, 3 new), with nothing under `app/**` and no protected file touched.
- **Harness spec:** two new measurements with 30 clips. The key paths (in-first and out-first) run right after the existing zoom step, and Ctrl+wheel runs last. The existing functions and rows are unchanged.
- **New probe** (`perf/lib/zoom-probe.ts`): counts waveform path rewrites and ruler changes. It is switched on only during these measurements and switched off afterwards.
- **New unit tests** (`perf/lib/zoom-probe.test.ts`): ZP1–ZP6.
- **Budgets:** 18 new rows added after the last existing 30-clip zoom row, plus the two ruler notes in the resources file.
- **Docs:** status lines in docs 212 and 213, and a new doc 222 with the numbers.

**Results:**
- **Perf run (`npm run test:perf`):** run twice, each time alone; both rc 0 with all assert rows passing.
  - The final run's interactions test took 337.5 s, 37.5 % of the 15-minute timeout (the stop line is 50 %).
  - Waveform rewrites are 0 on the in-first path and 60 on both out-first and wheel.
  - The slow steps match B's probe: keys 3 and 8 on out-first, steps 4 and 7 on wheel.
  - Every deterministic row gave the same value in all 3 passes, and the neighbouring 30-clip fade-drag rows are unchanged.
- **Unit tests:** run through a separate config outside `store/`; 29/29 pass.
- **Mutants:** m1–m4 each turned red, and the unmutated control was green. I added m5 (observer never disconnected), which turns ZP4 and ZP6 red. The browser mutants ran against the production build on a temporary port 5189, which I stopped afterwards. The dev server on 5173 couldn't be used because the harness gets 4 page errors there at load.
- **Typecheck and lint:** both rc 0. Biome normally skips `perf/`, so I checked the perf files separately in a scratch copy: clean.

**Code review:** 8/10, no Critical or High findings. Its one Medium was that the out-first long-frame row lost frames starting just before the key press: run 1 showed 73.1, 0, 0 while keydown was 80–96 in the same passes. I changed the new long-frame rows to count any frame overlapping the step window. In run 2, keys 3 and 8 show up in all three passes (50–55 ms and 83–84 ms). This differs slightly from the task's wording, so B should rule on it. The reviewer did not re-review these post-review changes; run 2 and the mutants verified them.

**Open items:**
- `lessons.md` doesn't exist anywhere in the project, so I followed the lessons the task cites from the task text.
- The report's description of the run steps doesn't mention the new steps, because that text is outside the files I was allowed to edit; B decides.
- The gate doesn't run the `perf/lib` unit tests yet (ROOT-REQ-VITEST-PERF-INCLUDE).
- **For B (architecture):** the zoom key loop and its live rule now exist twice. Proposal: one task after PERF-3d moves the old zoom measurement onto the shared step loop.

The full report, including the exact next checks for C, is at `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-304.md`, with logs and reports in `a-round-304/`.
